# LIBRARIES
```{r}
install.packages("schoRsch")
install.packages("readxl")
install.packages("ez")
library(schoRsch)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(ez)
```


# 2. SPATIAL STROOP
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
which_dat = "data/spatialStroopSOA-repl.xlsx"
stroop_data = readxl::read_excel(which_dat)
```

# pre_processing
```{r}
stroop_data$prev_Congruency = dplyr::lag(stroop_data$Congruency)
stroop_data$prev_Accuracy = dplyr::lag(stroop_data$Accuracy)

# data filtering
filtered_data = stroop_data[stroop_data$RT >= 200 & stroop_data$RT <= 1500,]

# filtering out trials - they sure do have an explanation for this lol
processed_data = filtered_data[!(filtered_data$`Trial Number` %in% c(1, 121, 241, 361, 481, 601, 721, 841)),]

# only correct trials
processed_data = processed_data %>% 
  filter(Accuracy == 1, 
         prev_Accuracy == 1)

write.csv(processed_data, file = "processed_data.csv")
```

## MEANS calculation -> current cong
```{r}
subj_means <- processed_data %>%
  filter(Accuracy == 1) %>% 
  mutate(Congruency = factor(Congruency, levels = c(1, 0),
                             labels = c("congruent", "incongruent"))) %>%
  group_by(Participant, Congruency) %>%
  summarise(mean_rt = mean(RT), .groups = "drop")

subj_means %>%
  group_by(Congruency) %>%
  summarise(M = mean(mean_rt), SD = sd(mean_rt), n = n())
```

## MEANS: prev_cong x cong --> for calculating cse
```{r}
cse_subj <- processed_data %>%
  filter(Accuracy == 1, prev_Accuracy == 1) %>% 
  mutate(across(c(Congruency, prev_Congruency),
                ~ factor(.x, levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("C", "I")))) %>%
  group_by(Participant, prev_Congruency, Congruency) %>%
  summarise(mean_rt = mean(RT), .groups = "drop")

cse_subj %>%
  group_by(prev_Congruency, Congruency) %>%
  summarise(M = mean(mean_rt), SD = sd(mean_rt), .groups = "drop")
```
## prev_cong and SOA = MEAN RTs
```{r}
prev_cong_rts <- processed_data %>%
  group_by(Participant, prev_Congruency) %>%
  summarise(mean_rt = mean(RT), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(prev_Congruency) %>%
  summarise(M = mean(mean_rt), SD = sd(mean_rt))

# SOA
soa_rts <- processed_data %>%
  group_by(Participant, SOA) %>%
  summarise(mean_rt = mean(RT), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(SOA) %>%
  summarise(M = mean(mean_rt), SD = sd(mean_rt))

print(soa_rts)
print(prev_cong_rts)
```



## ANOVA
```{r}
processed_data$Participant = as.factor(processed_data$Participant)
processed_data$Congruency = as.factor(processed_data$Congruency)
processed_data$prev_Congruency = as.factor(processed_data$prev_Congruency)
processed_data$SOA = as.factor(processed_data$SOA)

aov.rt = ezANOVA(processed_data,
                 dv = RT,
                 wid = Participant,
                 within = .(Congruency, prev_Congruency, SOA),
                 detailed = TRUE,
                 return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.rt)

```

## Plots - flanker
```{r}
summarise_se <- function(data, value, ...) {
  data %>%
    group_by(...) %>%
    summarise(M  = mean({{ value }}),
              SE = sd({{ value }}) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups = "drop")
}

# CE by SOA
ce_subj <- processed_data %>%
  group_by(Participant, SOA, Congruency) %>%
  summarise(rt = mean(RT), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Congruency, values_from = rt, names_prefix = "c") %>%
  mutate(CE = c0 - c1)

ce_sum <- summarise_se(ce_subj, CE, SOA)

ce_by_soa_stroop <- ggplot(ce_sum, aes(x = factor(SOA), y = M, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = M - SE, ymax = M + SE), width = 0.08) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 3, stroke = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 70), breaks = seq(0, 70, 10)) +
  labs(x = "SOA (ms)",
       y = "Congruency Effect (ms)\n(Incongruent RT - congruent RT)") +
  theme_classic()
ggsave(plot = ce_by_soa_stroop, "cse_by_soa_stroop.png")

# CE by SOA and previous congruency
ce_prev_subj <- processed_data %>%
  mutate(prev = factor(prev_Congruency, levels = c(1, 0),
                       labels = c("prev cong", "prev incong"))) %>%
  group_by(Participant, SOA, prev, Congruency) %>%
  summarise(rt = mean(RT), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Congruency, values_from = rt, names_prefix = "c") %>%
  mutate(CE = c0 - c1)

ce_prev_sum <- summarise_se(ce_prev_subj, CE, SOA, prev)

ce_prevcong_soa <- ggplot(ce_prev_sum, aes(x = factor(SOA), y = M, colour = prev, group = prev)) +
  geom_line(linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = M - SE, ymax = M + SE), width = 0.08) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 3, stroke = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("prev cong" = "#8CC63F", "prev incong" = "#6A3D9A")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 80), breaks = seq(0, 80, 10)) +
  labs(x = "SOA (ms)",
       y = "Congruency Effect (ms)\n(Incongruent RT - congruent RT)",
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_classic()
ggsave(plot = ce_prevcong_soa, "ce_prevcong_soa_stroop.png")

# CSE by SOA
cse_subj <- ce_prev_subj %>%
  select(Participant, SOA, prev, CE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = prev, values_from = CE) %>%
  mutate(CSE = `prev cong` - `prev incong`)

cse_sum <- summarise_se(cse_subj, CSE, SOA)

cse_by_soa <- ggplot(cse_sum, aes(x = factor(SOA), y = M)) +
  geom_col(fill = "black", width = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = M - SE, ymax = M + SE), width = 0.08) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 45), breaks = seq(0, 45, 5),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = "SOA (ms)", y = "CSE (ms)") +
  theme_classic()
ggsave(plot = cse_by_soa, "cse_by_soa_stroop.png")
```


## Post-hoc analyses
```{r}
library(broom)
cong_data<-subset(processed_data, Congruency == 1)
aov.cong = ezANOVA(cong_data,dv = RT,
                  wid = Participant,
                  within = .(prev_Congruency),
                  detailed = TRUE,
                  return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.cong)

incong_data<-subset(processed_data, Congruency == 0)
aov.incong = ezANOVA(incong_data,dv = RT,
                   wid = Participant,
                   within = .(prev_Congruency),
                   detailed = TRUE,
                   return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.incong)

k_data<-subset(processed_data, SOA == -100 | SOA == -50)
aov.k = ezANOVA(k_data,dv = RT,
                   wid = Participant,
                   within = .(prev_Congruency, Congruency),
                   detailed = TRUE,
                   return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.k)
```


## Mean error rates for experimental conditions = maybe the modeling? 
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
data = read_excel("data/spatialStroopSOA-repl.xlsx")
names(data)[2] = "TrialNum"
```


## calculate variables
```{r}
data$n1Accuracy = lag(data$Accuracy, 1)
data$n1Congruency = lag(data$Congruency, 1)
data$n1ArrowNum = lag(data$ArrowNum, 1)
firsttrials = c(0:7)*120+1
```

## exclude trials
```{r}
fdata = data %>%
  filter(!(TrialNum%in%firsttrials), RT >= 200, RT <= 1500)

gdata <- data.frame(Congruency=fdata$Congruency, 
                    n1Congruency=fdata$n1Congruency,
                    SOA=fdata$SOA,
                    Accuracy=fdata$Accuracy)

gdata %>% group_by(Congruency,n1Congruency,SOA) %>% summarise (x = mean(Accuracy))
```
